    Profile

    Macherie is a Shrine Maiden who lives with her younger brother in the village of Yune in the Desert Zone. Having been born with incredibly strong Alchemia, she is blind, but can use an ability called the Sight to ascertain her surroundings. Although mild-mannered in nature, when it comes to protecting those she cares about, she can summon up the bravery to take on even dangerous roles.

    Origin: Desert Zone
    Gender: Female
    Height: 152cm
    Weight: 40kg
    Birthday: Feb 27
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Wind Goddess
    Likes: Jayme, the wind
    Hobbies: Embroidery
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 遠野ひかる
